mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as lower rates reduce the discount rate applied to equity valuations.
failure_condition: The correlation between FEDFUNDS and 20-day forward returns is not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in inflation (CPIAUCSL > 215.5) signals potential monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when CPIAUCSL > 215.5 are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is rising and unemployment (UNRATE) is falling, it signals a strong labor market and economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 110 and UNRATE < 5.5 are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low housing market regime (HOUST < 900), the S&P 500 tends to produce negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as weak housing activity signals a deteriorating economic outlook.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when HOUST < 900 are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when UNRATE > 5.5 are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS <= 2.5%) and moderate inflation (CPIAUCSL between 210 and 220) signals a supportive monetary policy environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when FEDFUNDS <= 2.5 and 210 <= CPIAUCSL <= 220 are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production (INDPRO > 110.5) signals robust economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns when INDPRO > 110.5 are not significantly positive (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low housing market regime (HOUST < 900), the S&P 500 tends to have negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as weak housing activity signals a prolonged economic slowdown.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns when HOUST < 900 are not significantly negative (p>0.05) or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
